Our Process

A simple workflow that reduces mistakes and makes handover smooth.

1

Survey

We check camera angles, cable routes, power points, distances, and network readiness. This step prevents costly surprises later and ensures we quote accurately for the real scope of work.

2

Design & Quote

We propose the right equipment and plan for performance, storage, and expansion. You get a clear bill of materials with no hidden costs — what we quote is what you pay, quoted in Naira with no surprise additions.

3

Install & Test

We install cleanly, label properly, test everything, and do a clear handover. Every cable is tagged, every camera is verified, and you receive full documentation for future reference.

Before we start, we ask:

What must be covered? What’s the budget range? Do you need remote viewing? How long do you want storage? Is the network stable? Do you need future expansion? Is there reliable power or do you need solar backup? These questions prevent “redo” work later.

FAQ

Quick answers to the questions clients ask most often.

Yes. We configure secure remote access and confirm it works before handover. You can view your cameras from your phone or any web browser — no extra software needed. Works perfectly on MTN, Glo, Airtel, and 9mobile data.
Yes. Labeling and mapping reduces troubleshooting time massively in the future. Every cable is tagged at both ends and a full cable map is included in the handover documentation.
Yes. Recording works locally on the NVR/DVR. Internet is only needed for remote viewing. Your cameras keep recording even if the network goes down.
Yes. Preventive maintenance helps avoid sudden failures and keeps recordings reliable. We offer scheduled service plans to check cameras, clean lenses, verify storage, and update firmware.
It depends on the scope. A typical office CCTV installation takes 1-3 days. Larger projects like campus-wide deployments or fiber backbones may take 1-2 weeks. We give you a timeline during the quote phase.
We work with trusted brands like Hikvision, Dahua, TP-Link, Ubiquiti, and others depending on your budget and requirements. We recommend what fits your needs — not what gives us the highest margin.
Yes. All equipment comes with manufacturer warranty, and we provide a workmanship guarantee on our installation. If something we installed fails due to our work, we fix it at no extra cost.
